sources.title: ŌURA Surpasses 5.5 Million Rings Sold and Doubles Revenue for the Second Year in a Row, Empowering Millions to Live Better, Longer
highlights: URA serves customers in over 150 countries and is now available at more than 4,000 retail locations across twenty countries. Last year, ŌURA became the fastest-growing brand on Amazon in the U.S. To further increase accessibility, Oura Ring is HSA/FSA-eligible in the U.S. and has 1,000 commercial partners globally, including American Express, which now includes a benefit with ŌURA on their U.S.

sources.title: A Note to the Oura Community on Our Legal Home - The Pulse Blog
highlights: We’ve grown from a startup in Oulu into a global health technology company, with members in more than 150 countries and the majority of our revenue and investors now in the U.S. Creating a U.S. parent company is a legal and tax restructuring that allows for more simplicity in running the business, not a change in our products, teams, or mission.

request.query: ouraring.com company profile: industry, number of employees, countries it sells to, website languages, how its team works (remote, hybrid, or office), and whether it is hiring
request.systemPrompt: Research the company that owns the website ouraring.com. Prefer the company's own site (about, careers, help, store) and reputable business sources. Report facts only. If a fact cannot be determined, use "unknown" for strings, 0 for numbers, false for booleans, and an empty list for arrays. Never guess.
additionalQueries: ouraring.com careers: open roles, remote or hybrid or in-office work, office locations
ouraring.com about us: company size, headquarters, and countries or markets served
ouraring.com online store e-commerce platform and tech stack

highlights.query: company size, markets served, remote or office work, open roles, online store platform

employee_count.description: Approximate total number of employees; 0 if unknown

sells_to.description: Who the company primarily sells to

online_store_platform.description: E-commerce platform behind its online store (e.g. 'Shopify'); 'none' if it does not sell online; 'unknown' if it cannot be determined

countries_served.description: Countries or regions it sells or ships to, one per item. If it serves many, list its largest markets, or a count such as '150+ countries'

website_languages.description: Languages its website, store, or help pages are offered in

work_model.description: How most employees work, from its careers pages and job posts: remote-first, hybrid, or in an office

actively_hiring.description: Whether its careers page or job boards list open roles right now

handles_sensitive_data.description: Whether the company's core product involves customers' health or financial records (health tracking, banking, insurance, lending). Taking card payments at checkout does not count
